appearance_facts.fact: The leftmost vertical bar is orange, labeled Apple, and its top edge aligns with the 30 gridline.
The second bar is dark blue, labeled Samsung, and is the shortest bar on the chart.
The third bar is green, labeled Xiaomi, and its top edge is just below the 50 gridline.
The fourth bar is crimson, labeled Huawei, and is the tallest bar on the chart.
The rightmost bar is blue, labeled Others, and its top edge is between the 20 and 30 gridlines.

printed_facts.fact: The data label above the Apple bar reads 30%.
The data label above the Samsung bar reads 11%.
The data label above the Xiaomi bar reads 11%.
The data label above the Huawei bar reads 23%.
The data label above the Others bar reads 25%.
The vertical axis has tick labels from 0 to 100 in increments of 10, with no explicit unit label.

public_definitions: The task states the budget should be assigned to the brand with the highest current market_share.
uncertain: The chart's printed data labels (30%, 11%, 11%, 23%, 25%) do not match the visual heights of the bars, which appear to correspond to different values (e.g., Apple ~34, Huawei ~63).
